howto.name: Paste your JWT
howto.text: Copy the full token (three dot-separated base64url segments) into the input area.

howto.name: Inspect the decoded structure
howto.text: Header, payload, and signature are decoded in your browser. Standard claims (iss, sub, aud, exp, iat, nbf, jti) are highlighted; expiry status is shown.

howto.name: Copy decoded values
howto.text: Click Copy on any section to grab the JSON. Decoding never sends your token to a server.

faq.q: Is it safe to paste a real production JWT here?
faq.a: Yes — decoding happens entirely in your browser using JavaScript's atob(). No part of the token is sent to a server. Verify by checking DevTools → Network.
Not in this tool. Verification requires the issuer's signing key (HMAC secret for HS*, public key for RS*/ES*). The decoder displays the signature for inspection but doesn't validate it.

faq.q: What if my JWT is malformed?
faq.a: If the three-part dot structure is wrong, you'll see a clear error. If the base64 is malformed, the parser shows which segment failed.
